reasonToGo: Every river in the land starts under this shelf, and the company at the gate on its lip has been standing there since the city behind it fell.

hazards.name: The cold
hazards.description: Standing air off the old ice. It takes the hands, then the feet, then the judgement, in that order and quickly.

hazards.name: The white weather
hazards.description: Ground and sky go one colour and a man loses which way he came in. It takes a person's sense of direction first and their warmth second.

hazards.name: The crevasses
hazards.description: Splits in the old ice, bridged over with snow and invisible until the bridge goes. Every sled is sounded ahead of its own runners.
hazards.note: Absence hazard: a fall, not a field effect. The runtime enum has nothing for ground that is not there.

resources.name: The meltwater heads
resources.description: Braids running out from under the shelf, the head of every river in the basin and clean the whole year.

resources.name: The gravel head
resources.description: Old stone under the ice, exposed in bands where the shelf has drawn back, with no soil over it at all.

landmarks.name: The oath-gate
landmarks.description: A gate frame in the south lip with no gate hung in it and no wall on either side, and a sentinel still holding it.

landmarks.name: The crevasse shelf
landmarks.description: The broken front of the old ice, standing over stone and split from edge to edge.
